about: MAKEUP1 zone atlas: where each product sits on a face, anchored to the 468-point MediaPipe face mesh that ANAT1's face and photo landmarks share. One source of truth for the TypeScript library (registry/anatomy/makeup-zones.ts) and the Python pipeline (scripts/makeup/kumiki_makeup/zones.py).

units.frame: Rest frame of the face: millimetres, +x the face's own left, +y up, +z forward (ANAT1 convention). Photos are aligned to it by a similarity fit to the canonical mesh.
units.ew: Offsets, radii and softness are in eye widths (ew): the mean exocanthion-endocanthion distance of the face, so zones scale with the face.
units.sides: Zones with side 'both' are authored on the face's right (-x) and mirrored to the left through the mesh's mirror map; x offsets flip sign. 'center' zones are evaluated once.

points.mix: { "mix": [[i, w], ...] } a weighted mean of vertices (weights are normalised)
points.lerp: { "lerp": [P, Q, t] } the point a fraction t of the way from P to Q
points.off: optional [dx, dy, dz] in ew added in the face frame
points.r: stroke points only: half-width of the full-strength core, ew

shapes.stroke: A polyline of points with a radius at each point; strength is 1 inside the radius and falls to 0 across 'soft' (centred on the edge), measured in 3D.
shapes.polygon: A closed loop of points seen from the front (x, y); 'grow' moves the edge outward (ew), 'soft' is the blend width centred on the edge.

lateral-limbus.note: Outer edge of the iris looking ahead: about 71% of the eye width from the inner corner (iris 11.7 mm in a 30 mm eye). Observers preferred the brow peak here.

ear-front.note: In front of the ear, just under the zygomatic arch.

cheek-apple.note: The apple of the cheek: the most forward part of the malar fat pad, below the outer iris.

cheekbone-top.note: Top of the zygoma under the outer third of the eye.

hollow.note: Front end of the hollow under the cheekbone, between the outer canthus and the iris.

temple.note: Temple, level with the outer brow.

brow-head.note: Inner end of the brow, above the inner canthus.

brow-arch.note: Brow peak: the upper edge on the vertical through the lateral limbus.

brow-tail.note: Brow tail on the line from the nose wing (alare) through the outer canthus.

wing-tip.note: Tip of a winged liner: about 25 degrees above the lower lash line's extension, aimed at the brow tail.

lip-centre-lower.note: Fullest point of the lower lip.

film: A product is a thin pigment film over skin. At strength w (zone weight x coverage) it reflects w*hide*pigment itself, before light reaches the skin, and filters the rest: skin <- skin*((1-w) + w*(1-hide)*pigment). hide 0 is a transparent stain (a multiply blend), hide 1 opaque paint (a normal blend). The pigment is the product's colour over white (linear RGB).

foundation.note: Scattering pigment (titanium dioxide, iron oxides): hides blotches and redness, keeps the skin's own texture at sheer to medium coverage.

concealer.note: Denser foundation one or two shades lighter.

corrector.note: A complementary hue that cancels a discolouration before foundation.

contour.note: A cool, greyed shade deeper than the skin: imitates a shadow.

bronzer.note: A warm shade a little deeper than the skin: imitates a tan.

highlight.note: Light, low-chroma or golden pigment with reflective particles: imitates light on a high plane.

blush.note: A translucent red, rose or coral: imitates a flush (blood near the surface).

eyeshadow.note: Pressed or cream pigment on the lid and socket.

brow.note: Pencil or powder between and under the brow hairs.

lipstick.note: Cream lipstick; matte formulas hide more, sheers less.

lip-liner.note: A firm line on the vermilion border.

gloss.note: Clear or lightly tinted: mostly a specular change.

powder.note: Translucent setting powder: changes the finish, barely the colour.

matte.note: Powder scatters light diffusely: no shine.

satin.note: Close to bare skin's own sheen.

dewy.note: A wet-looking, broad, bright sheen on the high planes.

shimmer.note: Fine reflective particles: a sheen broken into points.

metallic.note: The highlight takes the pigment's colour.

zones.label: Foundation (whole face)
zones.note: Evens tone over the whole face and blends out at the jaw and hairline. Kept off the lips so their own colour stays.

zones.label: Under-eye brightening (concealer)
zones.note: Inverted triangle from the lower lash line toward the cheek: lifts the shadow of the tear trough. Lighter periorbital skin reads healthier (Jones et al. 2016).

zones.label: Tear trough (colour corrector)
zones.note: The inner half under the eye, where dark circles sit: peach or orange cancels blue, green cancels red.

zones.label: Cheek contour
zones.note: The hollow under the cheekbone, from in front of the ear toward the mouth corner, stopping below the outer canthus. A shadow here makes the cheekbone above read as higher.

zones.label: Temple contour
zones.note: Along the hairline at the temple: narrows a wide forehead and links the cheek contour to the hairline.

zones.label: Jawline contour
zones.note: Under the mandible from the jaw angle toward the chin: sharpens the jaw and separates it from the neck. Square faces soften the angle here.

zones.label: Nose sides
zones.note: Two fine shadows down the sides of the bridge from the brow head: narrow the nose. Professionally applied makeup made noses look smaller (Jones, Porcheron & Russell 2018).

zones.label: Cheekbone highlight
zones.note: The top of the cheekbone, curving up to the temple (the C shape round the outer eye): the plane that catches light above the contour.

zones.label: Nose bridge highlight
zones.note: A thin line down the bridge, stopping before the tip so the nose does not look longer.

zones.label: Forehead centre
zones.note: The centre of the forehead between the brows and the hairline.

zones.label: Chin centre
zones.note: The centre of the chin. Long faces skip it so the face does not look longer.

zones.label: Cupid's bow
zones.note: A fine light line just above the upper lip's peaks: sharpens the vermilion border so the lip looks fuller.

zones.label: Brow bone
zones.note: Under the outer half of the brow arch: lifts the brow.

zones.label: Bronzer (sun planes)
zones.note: Where the sun lands: the forehead edge, the cheekbone and the jaw (a '3' on each side). Warm, not a shadow.

zones.label: Blush on the apples
zones.note: Round, on the most forward part of the cheek: youthful. A redder cheek reads healthier (Jones et al. 2016; Stephen et al. 2009).

zones.label: Blush, lifted
zones.note: From the apple up and back toward the top of the ear: lifts and lengthens a round face.

zones.label: Blush, draped
zones.note: Along the cheekbone up to the temple, the 1970s-80s draping: sculpts without contour.

zones.label: Blush, high under the eye (igari)
zones.note: High on the cheek just under the eye, toward the nose (a Japanese style named after makeup artist Shinobu Igari): a flushed, just-warm look.

zones.label: Blush across the nose
zones.note: Over the apples and across the bridge of the nose, as the sun flushes a face.

zones.label: Eyelid (lid shade)
zones.note: From the lash line up to the crease: the lid colour.

zones.label: Crease (transition)
zones.note: Along the socket crease, deepest at the outer half and blended up: adds depth where the orbit recedes.

zones.label: Outer V
zones.note: The outer third of the lid up into the crease: the darkest shade, elongates the eye.

zones.label: Inner corner highlight
zones.note: A point of light at the inner canthus: opens close-set eyes.

zones.label: Lower lash line
zones.note: Smudged under the outer two thirds of the lower lashes.

zones.label: Upper liner
zones.note: Along the upper lash line, thin at the inner corner and thicker outward. Eyeliner and mascara make eyes look up to 6% larger (Matsushita, Morikawa & Yamanami 2015).

zones.label: Liner wing
zones.note: The flick beyond the outer corner, continuing the lower lash line up toward the brow tail.

zones.label: Brow fill
zones.note: The brow map: the head over the inner canthus, the peak on the vertical through the lateral limbus, the tail on the line from the nose wing through the outer canthus.

zones.label: Lips (lipstick)
zones.note: The vermilion. 'grow' overlines (about 1 mm at most reads natural).

zones.label: Lip liner
zones.note: A defined vermilion border.

zones.label: Lip centre (gradient, gloss)
zones.note: The inner lip, for a gradient (stained centre fading out) or gloss.

zones.label: Gloss point
zones.note: The fullest point of the lower lip, where gloss catches the light.
